verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for an AI assistant with desktop, mobile, and CLI clients, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, flag, or policy that lets users opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The community discussion of request marking in Claude Code concerns an anti-distillation mechanism, not a user-facing opt-out, so it neither supports nor disputes this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
